name: Gushers .7g Infused Pre-Roll Minis - 5 pack
description:
Smooth and savory, this hybrid strain offers mouthwatering fruit-inspired flavors that tantalize the taste buds. Its irresistible sweetness and fruity essence create a satisfying, flavorful experience with every puff, perfect for any occasion.

Our infused pre-rolls are crafted for those who demand premium quality and bold experiences. Each infused pre-roll is packed with premium cannabis, live resin terpenes, and liquid diamonds and then rolled in a kief coating. They deliver explosive flavor and unmatched potency, designed with a luxury ceramic tip for a smooth draw. Perfectly sized for convenience and ready to go wherever life takes you. Elevate your next session with Mitten Extracts infused pre-rolls—your go-to for flavor, potency, and quality.
